message.content:
A black-and-white editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. The masthead at the top reads "TEMPO" in large, bold, black letters. Above it, smaller text says "TOKOH PILIHAN 2014," and below "TEMPO" is "15-21 DESEMBER 2014." At the bottom, the word "RELAWAN" is printed in large, black block letters. A vertical barcode and "RP 35.000" are on the left edge.

The central composition consists of numerous line-drawn human faces of varying sizes. Three large figures dominate: a woman with long, straight hair on the upper left; a man with short hair and glasses on the lower left; and a man with long, shaggy hair and dark sunglasses on the lower right. A fourth, large partial face with a mustache and hat appears on the far right. Interspersed among their hair and shoulders are several smaller, full-body figures and smaller faces. One tiny figure in the center-left has an arm raised in a fist. Several figures have their hands placed on others' heads or shoulders. All elements are rendered in a consistent, detailed black line-art style on a white background.
